tag: Walk round a product taking photos with your phone, and get a 3D view shoppers can spin on your shop page.
hint: Pick how many, then tap Take a photo. The dial shows where to stand for each one.
sixSub: 6 photos, about a minute: front, back, both sides, top, bottom. Quick, but the shape is a guess.
roundSub: 72 photos in rings, about 10 minutes. Slower, but it looks just like the real thing.
